targets.name: Use the correct verb form after another verb or preposition
targets.reason: Verb-form errors remain the largest recurring pattern. W31 added 30 errors across five lesson days, while the three-week window contains 81 verb-form errors across 18 lesson days.
targets.trigger: Building a verb after a modal, another verb, or a preposition: can + base verb, ask/expect/help + complement, and to + verb.

error_examples.mistake: They can came back to the society.
error_examples.correction: They can come back to society.

error_examples.mistake: You can't expect them pay the same taxes.
error_examples.correction: You can't expect them to pay the same taxes.

error_examples.mistake: It can help our society more stable.
error_examples.correction: It can help our society become more stable.

targets.name: Choose the precise word form and collocation
targets.reason: Jack repeatedly chose a related but incorrect word or collocation. W31 added 18 word-choice errors across four lesson days, and the window contains 67 word-choice errors across 16 lesson days.
targets.trigger: Choosing among related forms or near-synonyms when naming a thing, action, quality, or relationship.

error_examples.mistake: The economic will be pretty good.
error_examples.correction: The economy will be pretty good.

error_examples.mistake: He could borrow a lot of money to a teacher.
error_examples.correction: He could lend a lot of money to a teacher.

targets.name: Mark plural count nouns and choose the right quantifier
targets.reason: Plural and quantifier problems returned strongly in W31: 23 errors across plural, quantifier, and determiner tags on four lesson days. The window contains 72 related errors across 13 lesson days.
targets.trigger: Talking about more than one countable person or thing, or choosing much/many, some, enough, most of, or a lot of.

error_examples.mistake: If they don't have enough consumer, their company will go bankrupt.
error_examples.correction: If they don't have enough consumers, their company will go bankrupt.

error_examples.mistake: Most of parents expected their children...
error_examples.correction: Most of the parents expected their children...
